items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Bill Brauer conducted the original oral history in 2003; Interviewee does not mention knowing him personally.

ctx.x: So, today we are going to, as I just mentioned, we are going to pick up from where you may have left off in your original Smithsonian oral history interview. Ken Kimery: Let me interrupt for just a second there, the levels are just a little bit low. Sorry about that.

Anyway, we are picking up from where you may have left off six or seven years ago when your oral history was done in 2003 by Bill Brauer. So, to begin, we just had Dr. Billy Taylor in the room; I don’t know if you ran into each other in the lobby there.
